lines.spoken: Typing Bangla on a new Mac just got easy again.
lines.caption: Typing Bangla on a new Mac just got easy again.

lines.spoken: Eye Avro stopped working on the latest Macs. Meet Avro Next.
lines.caption: iAvro stopped working on the latest Macs. Meet Avro Next.

lines.spoken: A free, native keyboard for Apple Silicon, ready for macOS twenty seven.
lines.caption: A free, native keyboard for Apple Silicon, ready for macOS 27.

lines.spoken: Type Bangla the way it sounds, just like Avro Phonetic.
lines.caption: Type Bangla the way it sounds, just like Avro Phonetic.

lines.spoken: Smart suggestions appear as you type.
lines.caption: Smart suggestions appear as you type.

lines.spoken: Pick a different word with the arrow keys, then press space.
lines.caption: Pick a different word with the arrow keys, then press Space.

lines.spoken: Next time, Avro Next remembers your choice.
lines.caption: Next time, Avro Next remembers your choice.

lines.spoken: Capital letters give you the extra letters, exactly like Avro.
lines.caption: Capital letters give you the extra letters, exactly like Avro.

lines.spoken: Punctuation, numbers and the taka sign come out in Bangla too.
lines.caption: Punctuation, numbers and the taka sign come out in Bangla too.

lines.spoken: Choose Avro Phonetic, Khipro or Probhat.
lines.caption: Choose Avro Phonetic, Khipro or Probhat.

lines.spoken: Change the suggestion bar, the font size, smart quotes and your own auto correct words.
lines.caption: Change the suggestion bar, font size, smart quotes and your own auto-correct words.

lines.spoken: And when a new version is out, Avro Next tells you.
lines.caption: And when a new version is out, Avro Next tells you.

lines.spoken: Getting it takes three steps. Download, install, and add it in Input Sources.
lines.caption: Getting it takes three steps: download, install, add it in Input Sources.

lines.spoken: Avro Next is free and open source. Download it today, and help make it better.
lines.caption: Free and open source. Download it today, and help make it better.
